p01.sub: Tower, this is Deck One. Eight cards on board, and one player at the controls. Pray for us.

s01.sub: Listen up, cards! In thirty seconds, the Thumb is going to play us.

s02.sub: The player, son. Big. Pink. Makes every decision down there.

k01.sub: He has four cards and a feeling.

s03.sub: He has been in Arena Two for eight months.

s04.sub: Green light! LMAO, you're up! Go, go, go!

s05.sub: Here it comes. Airdrop. Their whole push is on the bridge. Even he can't miss this.

e04.sub: We're losing! What's he doing now?

s07.sub: We are down a tower, and he is sending "we're all gonna make it".

s08.sub: He's leaking copium! Chillhouse! Move, move, move!

k04.sub: I have seen rug pulls faster than this.

y06.sub: Thirty seconds remaining. Last card: Cupsey.

s10.sub: Son, we are all eggs up here. Some of us just haven't hit the ground yet.

e06.sub: That is the worst speech I have ever heard.

s11.sub: It's the only one I've got. Go!

y07.sub: Opponent paperhands420 has left the match.

s12.sub: He did it. The kid did absolutely nothing. And it worked.

y09.sub: Plus twenty-eight Clout. New arena unlocked: Strip Mall Lot.

s13.sub: Meme Royale. Free to play. And please. Play better than this guy.
